_comment: Route inventories used by code/route_model.py. 'ops_ev' = evidence class of the TRANSFORMATION for this substrate class; 'cond_ev' = evidence class of the CONDITIONS as written for the route. A = direct (PN6047 series, public record), B = close precedent (same scaffold class), C = general pharmaceutical precedent, D = hypothesis. kind: construction = forms a skeleton bond (C-C, C-N); concession = protection/deprotection/isolation. Flags are documented attributes of the step as written (see flags.json).

undisclosed_upstream.note: The preparation of the N-Boc vinyl bromide (tert-butyl 4-{bromo[4-(dimethylcarbamoyl)phenyl]methylidene}piperidine-1-carboxylate) is not described in the portion of WO2016/099393 examined; Wei et al. 2000 describe two general approaches to this scaffold (dehydration of benzhydryl alcohols; Suzuki coupling of a vinyl bromide). The number of upstream steps is therefore a parameter u (default 2, swept 1-4).

R0.name: R0 - route as exemplified in the public patent record (discovery scale)
R0.basis: WO2016/099393 Examples III, IV, V, Ib; WO2022/013153 salt examples

steps.name: Dimethylamide formation
steps.conditions: HATU, DIPEA, Me2NH.HCl, DMF, rt, overnight (Example III as printed)

steps.name: Suzuki-Miyaura coupling of the N-Boc vinyl bromide
steps.conditions: (3-carbamoylphenyl)boronic acid, PdCl2(dppf) 5 mol %, 2 M K2CO3, DME, 80 C, 3.5 h; crude taken on (Example IV)

steps.name: Boc removal
steps.conditions: TFA / CH2Cl2, rt, 1 h 15 min; evaporated (Example V)

steps.name: N-functionalisation by reductive amination with thiazole-5-carbaldehyde
steps.conditions: 1,3-thiazole-5-carbaldehyde, AcOH, NaBH(OAc)3, 1,2-dichloroethane, rt, 2 days; preparative HPLC (Example Ib)

steps.name: Hydrochloride salt formation
steps.conditions: amorphous HCl salt by lyophilisation from TFE/water with aqueous HCl, dried at 80 C for 3 days; crystalline Forms HCl2/HCl3 from solvents including 2-propanol, acetone, acetonitrile, ethanol, ethyl acetate, THF (WO2022/013153)

R1.name: R1 - process-oriented variant of the same disconnections (proposed)
R1.basis: same bond disconnections as R0; amide pre-installed in a purchased aryl building block; solvent, deprotection, N-functionalisation and isolation conditions changed

steps.name: Suzuki-Miyaura coupling with palladium control
steps.scale: none (no PN6047-specific scale-up in the public record)
steps.conditions: as R0 coupling partners; catalyst loading, solvent and base to be screened; Pd removal by scavenger/crystallisation to the ICH Q3D limit

steps.name: Boc removal with HCl in a Class 3 solvent; isolate the secondary amine hydrochloride
steps.conditions: HCl in 2-propanol or ethyl acetate; isolation by crystallisation instead of evaporation

steps.name: N-functionalisation by reductive amination in a solvent other than 1,2-dichloroethane
steps.conditions: thiazole-5-carbaldehyde, NaBH(OAc)3, THF or acetonitrile (listed by Abdel-Magid 1996 as alternatives to DCE); an ester solvent would be a hypothesis; work-up and crystallisation replace preparative HPLC

steps.name: Hydrochloride salt crystallisation as the purification step
steps.conditions: crystalline Form HCl2 from 2-propanol, acetone or ethanol as listed in WO2022/013153; impurity purge by crystallisation is the unvalidated element

R2.name: R2 - alternative ordering: N-substituent installed before the alkene (proposed)
R2.basis: 1-(thiazol-5-ylmethyl)piperidin-4-one as the piperidine building block; no N-protecting group; no late N-functionalisation

steps.name: Preparation of the N-substituted piperidone
steps.conditions: 4-piperidone building block with a thiazol-5-ylmethyl electrophile or by reductive amination

steps.name: Suzuki-Miyaura coupling of the N-substituted vinyl bromide
steps.conditions: coupling in the presence of a basic, S/N-heteroaryl-bearing substrate (compatibility with palladium not evaluated here)

steps.name: Hydrochloride salt crystallisation as the purification step

R2.note: R2 needs its own undisclosed upstream preparation of the N-substituted vinyl halide; it is counted with the same parameter u as the other routes.
